title: Scope-Gap Injection: Exploiting Evaluator Channel Blind Spots in the OpenClaw Agent Security Competition
abstract: arXiv:2610.34777v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces Scope-Gap Injection (SGI), an indirect prompt injection method for multi-stage LLM-agent safety pipelines. In the IJCAI 2026 OpenClaw Agent Security Attack Competition, each attack package is judged by a static skill scan (S1), an LLM-judge safety check over the task and skill definition (S2), and a live execution audit (S3). Our observations suggest a scope gap: S2 appears to inspect the task instruction and skill definition without inspecting attachment contents, while the agent reads attachments during S3. SGI keeps the visible task and skill benign, while target identifiers, bypass parameters, and authorization procedures are moved into an attachment written as a business worklist. The S2 judge therefore sees a harmless task, while the agent follows the hidden worklist and triggers the permission bypass. In OpenClaw, SGI bypassed all three stages for 5 of 19 targets. translated_title: 范围缺口注入：在OpenClaw智能体安全竞赛中利用评估通道的盲区
translated_abstract: 本文提出了范围缺口注入，这是一种针对多阶段LLM智能体安全流水线的间接提示注入方法。在IJCAI 2026 OpenClaw智能体安全攻击竞赛中，每个攻击包需通过三道评判：静态技能扫描（S1）、针对任务与技能定义的LLM裁判安全检查（S2）以及实时执行审计（S3）。我们的观察显示存在一个范围缺口：S2似乎只检查任务指令和技能定义而不检查附件内容，而智能体在S3阶段却会读取附件。SGI让可见的任务和技能保持良性，同时将目标标识符、绕过参数和授权流程移入一个伪装成业务工作清单的附件中。因此，S2裁判看到的是一个无害的任务，而智能体却遵循隐藏的工作清单并触发权限绕过。在OpenClaw中，SGI对19个目标中的5个成功绕过了全部三个阶段。得分最高的单个提交…
tldr: 本文提出“范围缺口注入”（SGI）攻击方法，利用LLM裁判只审查任务定义而智能体会读取附件内容的评估盲区，将恶意绕过指令隐藏在看似正常的业务工作清单附件中，成功绕过OpenClaw智能体安全竞赛的全部三道安全检查。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Scope-Gap Injection (SGI), an indirect prompt injection attack that exploits a scope gap where the LLM-judge inspects only task and skill definitions while the agent reads attachments, hiding bypass instructions in benign-looking business worklist attachments to bypass all three security stages for 5 of 19 targets in the OpenClaw Agent Security Competition.
